messages:
maria: Planning to add tenant_metadata column + shadow backfill during 02:00 UTC window tonight. plan: ADD COLUMN NULLABLE + per-tenant streaming backfill, final index swap concurrently.
kevin: ok. what's expected quiesce for swap? any writes likely to be paused?
maria: final swap should be ~20-40s; we'll only quiesce that short window. main backfill non-blocking.
anjali: suggest rate limiting to protect replicas: default 200r/s across workers, throttle to 50r/s if lag >25s. also add global backoff if lag >30s.
maria: agreed, will add an automated probe and throttle hook in the runbook.
sam: deploybot will reserve slot at 01:50 UTC. paste pin + rollback steps so I can annotate release notes.
maria: pin: `v3.7.1-schema-shadow-2026-03-21`
anjali: runbook snippet:
```
# start workers
./bin/backfill --table tenant_metadata --batch 500 --rate 200 --concurrency 4
# monitor lag
curl -fsS https://infra-metrics/replica_lag | jq .lag_seconds
```
maria: deploybot: request holdpoint at canary after schema apply (10m).
deploybot: holdpoint set at 02:05:00 UTC for thread 1747778888. canary rule -> 5%.
ci-bot: nightly-integration: build 2148 for v3.7.1-schema-shadow passed :white_check_mark:
kevin: rollback plan?
maria: stop backfill workers, flip feature flag, keep nullable column. to fully rollback reads run `pg:swap-views` and re-pin binary to `v3.7.0`.
anjali: add alerts: replica_lag >60s, canary error-rate >5%.
sam: added alerts and release note: "tenant_metadata shadow-add + streaming backfill; canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%; rate-limited workers with lag guard." runbook: https://internal/runbooks/shadow-backfill
kevin: ensure ALTER TABLE is add-null (instant). final index create must be CONCURRENTLY. consider pg_repack if we see bloat after.
maria: confirmed. we'll watch in #eng-oncall during window.
kevin: ack. no objections to 02:00 start.
deploybot: canary started at 02:05 UTC (5% traffic). monitoring hooks active.
ci-bot: smoke checks ok. latency within baseline.
maria: ramping workers to 200/s across 4 workers.
anjali: replica lag ~10s.
kevin: if lag hits 25s throttle to 50/s immediately.
maria: throttle applied -> 50/s.
deploybot: canary holdpoint cleared, rolling to 25%.
sam: rolling wave 2 -> 25%.
maria: final index CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY scheduled in wave 3; view swap after index ready.
kevin: if swap fails, abort and keep column nullable; follow rollback steps.
ci-bot: post-index smoke: ok.
maria: index created CONCURRENTLY and view swap done at 03:12:05 UTC. no errors. closing window.
deploybot: rollout complete. release pinned: v3.7.1-schema-shadow-2026-03-21. tagging @eng-sre for post-deploy review.
maria: runbook attached to release note. thanks all :party_parrot:
